title: We need to continue to ensure full `formal-ai` support
body:
- https://gist.githubusercontent.com/konard/d0553b8e1b5ed88f1b8241f539ba4907/raw/a45f64f35cbf5032e44e1d779b82f45d24b0d405/tmp-hive-mind-log-upload-XOq3KX-sanitized.log.txt - here it is clear, that we for some reason used not formal-ai, but other model, and that is clearly must be reported to https://github.com/link-assistant/agent. When we ask for formal-ai, it should be not possible for Agent CLI to use any LLMs, unless formal-ai itself does it using bash command or in some other way. The driving model for formal-ai must be formal-ai only (github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai), which must be accessed via `formal-ai with agent ...` command delivered by github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai. If any features are missing in github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai, they also must be reported as blockers here, so we can pause development of pull request until all blockers resolved.
- https://gist.githubusercontent.com/konard/3df8fd313b592842d9dcf34bd265d7ca/raw/f33cbd670aec61a257f37466b9c2aa532269d4c0/tmp-hive-mind-log-upload-PhU3X2-sanitized.log.txt (check no logs are missing from all auto restart/resumes from today) - here no actual code changes were produced, and that triggered auto-restart/resume sequence, we must ensure that is fixed at Formal AI side (as its logic must be able to make if from start to the end).
- Similar problem here - https://gist.githubusercontent.com/konard/111bc2c200954b7f524e5f314e49f43e/raw/80fa567a7769ea83959a4afd6594ddce6318cc85/tmp-hive-mind-log-upload-8GWnaH-sanitized.log.txt (check no logs are missing from all auto restart/resumes from today)

Also looks like formal AI has problems with markdown output (all text, that includes tabs/spaces and or code, should use codeblocks, so that will be translated nicely to GitHub comments from last message of Formal AI).

Make sure all requirements from all previous issues are fully full-filled in Hive Mind, agent CLI and Formal AI itself (if something is wrong - report issues in last two repositories).
- https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/2119
- https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/2130

Also make sure to carefully analyze logs for all potential errors, warnings, false negatives, false positives, and make sure we fix it all in Hive Mind, and report issues to other our repositories.

We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration.

If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them.

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
